title: Electron 42 Windows native-module build regression
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

42.x.y

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Windows

### Operating System Version

GHA Windows 2022

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

41.5.0

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

I don't know how to test

### Expected Behavior

Native modules rebuilt against Electron 42 headers on Windows with MSVC should not fail to build

### Actual Behavior

Electron 42 ships a `cppgc/heap.h` header that unconditionally calls:

```cpp
__builtin_frame_address(0)
```

MSVC does not support `__builtin_frame_address`, so the build fails with an error like:
```
error C3861: '__builtin_frame_address': identifier not found
```

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

This may need fixing upstream in Node but thought I would open here first for visibility...
